request: マンモスに乗れるといい。

controls: R / ride button: mount or dismount
implementation.combat: Dismount before attacking, gathering or eating. Occupied mammals cannot be hunted; staff attacks cannot reach riders.
implementation.collision: Original body radius and swept solver, 16 tested exit directions; narrow routes may require dismounting.
implementation.render: Original TRELLIS GLBs; runtime seated skin pose follows animated mammoth spine. Camera backs out to 9 m. Nearby canopies hiding the rider are culled per view. No new mesh, texture, GLB fallback or extra animation mixer.
implementation.approach: Explicit request follows moving target at 1.2 s intervals; cancels with other input, disconnect, occupancy or a 10 s stall. Mount still requires server validation.

rollout.method: Existing development server automatically restarted as code changed; frontend reloaded after restoring the original selected profile.

limitations: Mammoths retain their conservative full-body radius, so some forest passages, bridges and long routes are not traversable while riding. A rejected target gives a notice; dismount to continue.
This update adds riding, not permanent saves or reconnect recovery.
